note: The DOI fetch was refused (provenance). The ScienceDirect URL came from a WebSearch, and only the abstract and highlights were shown; the full text is paywalled. The abstract says heat recovery is 'not economical feasible' in conventional air-cooled centres but is feasible with rear door cooling. The fetch summary also gave ERF figures (about 55% at the condenser, 25-45% from return air) from a citing review, Huang et al. 2020. That is secondhand, so I did not use it. Check against the full-text upload.
